intro: Hi, I’m Rudtea. I turn ideas into thoughtful digital experiences. A little design, a little code, and a lot of curiosity.
aboutTitle: Good things start with a little curiosity.
about:
I’m a maker at heart, drawn to the space where design and technology meet. I like asking questions, exploring new perspectives, and making complicated things feel simple.

This is my little corner of the internet — a place for the things I make, the ideas I’m exploring, and whatever comes next. Make yourself at home.
